notes.subject: pikinini
notes.rationale: זרע i min sidin/kaikai pikinini — Tok Pisin 'pikinini' bilong man, i no 'sidin' (lo D4)

notes.subject: כמעתיו
notes.rationale: smol hap — KJV 'gravel thereof' (smol ston long san) vs JPS 'grains' — mi holim pasin bilong san

translation: Na pikinini bilong yu bai i kamap olsem san, na ol pikinini bilong bel bilong yu olsem ol smol graun i stap long san; nem bilong em bai ol i no ken katim em i go ausait long ol manmeri bilong en, na ol i no ken bagarapim em, i no lus long pes bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: olsem ol smol graun i stap long san

i no lus long pes bilong mi
